paragraphs.speaker: M
paragraphs.en: Margaret, we have been through this for almost a year now, back and forth making alterations! Are you sure you want to make a sponsorship deal for your clients or not? Frankly, some people at my end are running out of patience.

paragraphs.speaker: M
paragraphs.en: Okay, then. This here is your yearly performance review. You've been with the company for three years and under my direct supervision for the past 12 months. This report is mostly good, but there are a couple of issues we must discuss. We'll go through the main points together now.
paragraphs.zh: 好的。这是你的年度绩效评估报告。你在公司已经三年了，在过去12个月里一直在我的直接指导下工作。这份报告总体上很好，但有几个关键问题我们需要深入讨论。我们现在一起来过一遍重点。
paragraphs.evidence_text: This here is your yearly performance review.

paragraphs.speaker: W
paragraphs.en: Thank you, David. I'm ready. I really appreciate having formal feedback like this.
paragraphs.zh: 谢谢你，戴维。我准备好了。我非常珍惜得到这样正式的工作反馈。

paragraphs.speaker: M
paragraphs.en: Well, to start with, your overall productivity has been quite impressive, and your project management skills have clearly improved. You deserve recognition for your dedication and technical excellence.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，你整体的工作效率非常令人印象深刻，项目管理能力也有了显著提升。你的专注和技术过硬值得充分肯定与表彰。
paragraphs.evidence_text: You deserve recognition for your dedication and technical excellence.

paragraphs.speaker: W

paragraphs.speaker: M

paragraphs.evidence_text: I just want to save time and get straight to the point, so I omit polite formulas.
